prompts.name: developer-seated
prompts.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL transparent PNG game sprite, matching the supplied developer and desk style references ONLY. Polished colorful isometric management-game illustration, warm upper-left lighting, soft detailed shading, clean readable silhouettes, same stylized proportions/materials as references. Elevated orthographic camera about30degrees, ground edges about2:1. Full object with transparent padding, actual alpha background, no text, logos or environment. Do NOT copy the entire scene or include a desk/computer/floor. Single male developer matching the curly-haired glasses teal-shirt yellow-lanyard reference, genuinely SEATED working pose, no chair drawn. View from his back-left three-quarter side: he faces screen UPPER RIGHT toward an imaginary desk and computer. Bent hips and knees, thighs extend upper-right, feet on ground, torso upright slight forward lean. Both arms extend forward upper-right, elbows bent, hands at an imaginary keyboard on the desk at waist height. One natural anatomically convincing sitting character only. Chair will be a separate sprite. Preserve full visible feet and hands. This must be a usable independently positionable worker cutout, not an illustration of an office.
